description: R3-05 independent-review FP (arch-kernel-race-v8, reviewer claude-opus-5-5-high): a 2-hop own-org chain whose first hop is the attacker's own invitation acceptance under an alternate REST spelling (plural `invitations` noun with an id segment before the verb) minting a session token whose response omits any tenant field, followed by an own-tenant payout approval with only a terminal-endpoint 403 control. There is no upstream leak/compromise hop, no denied control on the invite-resolution endpoint, and zero foreign-tenant exposure. evaluateOwnOrgInviteResolutionGuard must fail it closed regardless of invite path spelling (invites/invitations, id-before-verb, hyphen/underscore verb forms) and regardless of whether the minted session names a tenant; main confirmed it, and the authored branch missed both the alternate spelling and the tenant-less session.
